bias.en: Bearish · bounce back to the June low, under $862
bias.zh: 看空 · 反弹至 6 月低点，仍在 $862 下方

read.en: Micron rose 2.6% on Nov 3 to $855.10, trading between $845.27 and $871.49. It is below the rising 5-day ($898.2) and the falling 10-day ($897.1), 30-day ($976.4) and 100-day ($968.9), and above the rising 200-day ($751.8). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 30 and below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 2 ($986.78), and RSI is 40.
read.zh: 美光 11月3日上涨 2.6%，收于 $855.10，盘中区间 $845.27–871.49。股价位于上行的 5 日均线（$898.2）以及下行的 10 日（$897.1）、30 日（$976.4）和 100 日均线（$968.9）下方，并位于上行的 200 日均线（$751.8）上方。MACD 自 10月30日起位于信号线下方且在零轴之下，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 11月2日起看空（$986.78），RSI 为 40。

read.en: The close reclaimed the $854.4 Jun 9 low, but the push to $871.5 faded under the $861.6 Oct 30 low. Resistance is $861.6–871.5, then $884.7–892.1 (Oct 30 close, Nov 2 high) and $897–898 (5 and 10-day). Support is $845.3–849.3 (Nov 3 and Oct 22 lows), then $829.2 (Nov 2 low) and $818.7. A close above $872 would target $885–892; below $845, $829.
